title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sasaki, a tired middle-aged office worker, unwinds with a cigarette behind a supermarket, where he chats with a friendly young employee, Tayama. He does not realize that the cashier he quietly admires inside the store is the same woman, and a gentle slow-burn romantic comedy follows (to verify).
life_message: It holds up small kindnesses, rest and honest connection as a relief from tiring work life.
